Exchange Hub · External supplier

Survey inventory API

Use your assigned API key to read only the live surveys and clients allocated to your supplier account, then send the respondent to the secure start_link returned for that survey.

Base URL

{{ base_url }}

All API URLs below are relative to this base URL.

Authentication

Send the plaintext API key provided by Exchange Hub on every API request. Keep it server-side; never put it in browser JavaScript or a public URL.

X-API-Key: exh_your_key_here

The alternate format Authorization: Api-Key exh_your_key_here is also accepted.

1. Fetch live inventory

Only surveys permitted by your active client allocations, project rules and CPI policy are returned. Pagination is standard; follow next until it is null.

GET {{ base_url }}/api/v1/surveys/?status=live&page=1&page_size=50
X-API-Key: exh_your_key_here

Useful optional filters include search, country_code, client, min_cpi, max_cpi and ordering. Use the returned local_id for the detail endpoints.

{
  "count": 1,
  "next": null,
  "results": [{
    "local_id": "20260800123456",
    "survey_id": "5931305",
    "name": "Example survey",
    "country_code": "US",
    "cpi": "1.25",
    "loi": 12,
    "incidence_rate": "35.00",
    "start_link": "{{ base_url }}/survey/start?entry=..."
  }]
}

2. Read quota and targeting before routing

These endpoints return the normalized quota and pre-screening data used by Exchange Hub. The data reflects the latest provider synchronization.

GET {{ base_url }}/api/v1/surveys/{local_id}/quotas/
GET {{ base_url }}/api/v1/surveys/{local_id}/targeting/
GET {{ base_url }}/api/v1/surveys/{local_id}/details/
X-API-Key: exh_your_key_here

Do not manufacture answer IDs or alter provider mappings. If you collect profile data in your own flow, preserve the precise accepted values returned by targeting.

3. Route the respondent

  1. Request inventory from your backend.
  2. Choose a live survey and optionally inspect its quota/targeting.
  3. Redirect the respondent’s browser to that response’s start_link.
  4. Do not edit, decode, cache across users, or append user/survey/RID/PID parameters to the link. It is a one-time, authenticated entry token.
A fresh start_link is generated in the inventory response for your API key. If you need to refresh an unconsumed token, POST its existing entry value to /api/v1/surveys/entry-link/ with the same API key.

Result callbacks

When configured by Exchange Hub, terminal results are sent to the HTTPS callback URLs registered for your API key. Treat eventId as the idempotency key: repeated delivery of the same event must not create duplicate crediting.

status1 complete, 2 terminate, 3 quota full, 4 quality terminationsurveyIdThe identifier mode selected for this API keyprojectIdExchange Hub project IDpidSupplier-safe respondent journey identifiereventIdIdempotency key for this terminal eventtimestampTerminal provider result timestatusSourceHow the terminal result was receivedtermReason / termCategoryProvided when available for non-complete outcomeshashPresent only when optional HMAC-SHA256 signing is enabled
GET https://supplier.example/callback?status=1&surveyId=...&projectId=...&pid=...&eventId=...&timestamp=...

Postman quick start

  1. Create base_url = {{ base_url }} and secret api_key with the issued key.
  2. Create a GET request to {{base_url}}/api/v1/surveys/?status=live.
  3. Add header X-API-Key: {{api_key}}, then Send.

Expected errors: 401 invalid/revoked/expired key, 403 insufficient permission, 404 survey not visible to the key, and 429 temporary rate limit. Do not retry 4xx authentication or scope errors automatically.
